description: The EU Gas Model is a Julia linear-programming testbed for European gas-security policies, demand reductions and transport bottlenecks. Its README documents alternative model branches and input controls. The provider is ZERO Lab, repository maintained by ml6802. Coverage: The documented branches cover April 2025 to March 2026 and April 2022 to March 2024. Hungary and Slovakia are explicitly excluded. Access: The public repository provides run and input instructions. A separate LP solver is required; no model execution was attempted. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: Hard-coded paths require changes, solver availability is external, and the documented country exclusions limit geographic interpretation. For simulation it supports policy scenarios and assessment of gas-supply constraints. Related resources: model-gasmodels-jl covers another gas-network optimisation tool. No direct use of it by this model was established.
